answer: During a typhoon, you should check the official LSPU-LB Facebook page for campus-wide class suspensions, and your professor's Messenger group and Google Classroom for class-level announcements before you travel. If you are already on campus in strong wind or heavy rain, stay indoors, keep away from windows and glass doors, stay out of open areas and away from trees, posts, and loose signs, and follow the guards and faculty. Do not travel through flooded roads or walk under fallen wires. Go home only when it is safe, and check announcements before coming back to campus.
